headline: Today in cardiometabolic health: Interplay Between Heart Failure Events, New-Onset Diabetes, and Finerenone in Heart Failure With Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction
bullets: Interplay Between Heart Failure Events, New-Onset Diabetes, and Finerenone in Heart Failure With Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction

Berberine lowers LDL cholesterol in randomized trials. I'm interested in how that connects to ApoB, artery plaque, and the gut microbiome. A meta-analysis pooling 14 placebo-controlled trials found an average LDL reduction of approximately 18 mg/dL. Recen
